**Introduction to Horsehead Corporation**

Horsehead Corporation is a leading innovator in the chemical and specialty materials industry, headquartered at **300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, PA 15061-2295**. With a rich history of technological advancement and sustainable practices, the company has established itself as a trusted partner in delivering high-performance chemical solutions to industries worldwide. Specializing in the production of zinc-based products, advanced materials, and environmentally responsible manufacturing processes, Horsehead Corporation plays a pivotal role in sectors such as automotive, construction, agriculture, and renewable energy.

Founded on a commitment to excellence, Horsehead Corporation leverages cutting-edge research and development to create products that meet the evolving demands of modern industries. The company’s state-of-the-art facilities in Monaca, Pennsylvania, are equipped with advanced production technologies, ensuring efficiency, quality, and adherence to stringent environmental and safety standards. By prioritizing sustainability, Horsehead Corporation minimizes its ecological footprint while maximizing resource efficiency, aligning with global efforts to promote a circular economy.

Beyond its core operations, Horsehead Corporation fosters strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and communities, emphasizing collaboration and innovation. With a dedicated team of experts and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to drive progress in chemical manufacturing, delivering solutions that enhance performance, durability, and environmental stewardship. As a forward-thinking enterprise, Horsehead Corporation remains at the forefront of the industry, shaping the future of chemical innovation.
